expiration_rule: Friday of the next calendar week; this window has no holiday Fridays
selection_rule: Historical as_of chain: strictly closest put strike below S and call strike above S; standard 100-share contracts only
price_unit: USD per share; one standard contract premium = price * 100
price_field: unadjusted daily aggregate c; not buyable ask; timestamps not synchronized to stock close
